messages:
sarah: Heads-up: planning a micro change-window tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. Need cross-svc compatibility check for API v2.4.0 -> runtime 3.1.0 -> console 5.7.x. Router has an optional header-split change that might be breaking. Who can own pin decisions + rollback criteria? @kevin @mike
kevin: Ran quick staging smoke. runtime 3.1.0 expects header metadata v2.4.0+ and a tiny contract tweak (opts.new_meta). Staging diff: `+ opts.new_meta` in api/contract.proto. No failures so far but KV cache eviction defaults changed.
deploybot: deploybot: Lock acquired for micro-window 23:00 UTC by @sarah. To proceed run `/deploy orchestrate --wave microwindow-1 --pin` or confirm and I'll start the wave.
mike: Router team: header-split is behind a feature flag. We can enable for 10% traffic as a canary. If we see >0.5% 5xx or latency p95 jump >100ms, flip back. I can monitor and flip.
ana: Proposing pins: API -> `v2.4.0-rc2`, runtime -> `3.1.0`, console -> `5.7.2`. PR for release notes: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/412 :thumbsup: 
julia: Rollback criteria suggestion: error-rate >0.5% sustained over 10m OR p95 latency >200ms. Owner for immediate rollback: @mike (router) and @kevin (api). Run rollback playbook: 1) abort ramp 2) toggle router ff -> 0% 3) pin services back to last stable 4) verify traffic.
kevin: Quick preflight check script added: `curl -sS https://staging-api.internal/_meta | jq .header_version` and `kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime KV_EVICTION_MAX=500MB` — note the eviction knob.
deploybot: deploybot: initiating canary wave (microwindow-1) -> 10% traffic steer to API v2.4.0-rc2 on dedicated pool. Will post status every 2m.
sarah: I'll watch console telemetry and token-level perf dash. @oncall-sre please standby. If green after 20m we'll ramp to 50% then 100%.
oncall-sre: oncall-sre: Preflight checks OK. No alerts in last 30m. I'll keep an eye on errors and latency.
mike: Observed small 503 spike minute 6 in EU region (~0.8% for 3m). Temporarily cutting header-split back to 0% and pausing ramp. Aborting further ramps.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary aborted per @mike. Rolling back API -> `v2.3.9` and runtime -> `3.0.8`. Console remains pinned at `5.7.1`. Executing rollback now... done.
sarah: Thanks team. Post-mortem action items: 1) router: RCA on 503s and header fanout (owner @mike) 2) update release notes marking canary aborted (owner @ana) 3) schedule follow-up micro-window after fixes (owner @sarah). We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
